custom_instructions: Before any git operation (commit, push, PR, branch): load context/02-shared/git-conventions.md and follow it exactly. Do NOT skip the confirmation gate — always show the user the diff summary + draft commit message and ask 'Should I commit?' before running git commit. Do NOT use --no-verify. The git-guard PreToolUse hook hard-blocks --no-verify, git add -A/., direct commit/push to main/master/develop, and force-push; a blocked call means you violated git-conventions.md — fix the command, do not work around the hook.
